reviews.basis: The upstream helper changes from four positional arguments to one object. Its category attributes and repeated user child remain present. The new IR recovers name/value/dhash and users[] paths; the old user paths incorrectly passed through name. This does not establish full branch coverage.

The preserved facebookRelayOperation module exports literal 27747880408206174 in the old set and 27796221486653417 in the new set. Both values agree with their IR. This establishes a persisted operation ID change in these snapshots, not server compatibility.
